verdict.rationale: Codex Cloud supports delegating longer tasks to run autonomously in isolated cloud environments, triggered from GitHub/GitLab/Linear/Slack or the web/CLI, running in parallel without tying up local resources, then returning a diff/summary or PR when done — this is a clear background-autonomous-automation workflow. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on verification of scheduled/triggered automation reliability, and community evidence focuses more on interactive CLI/model quality than cloud automation specifically.
